enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Pull blanket up. Stretch legs. Sigh. Turn to back. Move arm. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and taking a shower
enriched_activities.desc: Get out of bed. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Wrap towel around body. Walk to sink. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating breakfast with Member 1 (toast and tea prepared by Member 1)
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into kitchen. Say good morning to Member 1. Sit down at table. Pick up toast. Take bite. Chew. Swallow. Pick up tea cup. Sip tea. Put down cup. Continue eating. Talk to Member 1. Finish toast. Drink remaining tea. Stand up. Pick up plate and cup. Walk to sink. Rinse plate and cup. Place in dishwasher. Walk back to table. Wipe mouth with napkin. Push chair in. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing sketchbook and laptop for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into bedroom. Open closet. Select shirt. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Walk to desk. Pick up sketchbook. Place in bag. Pick up laptop. Place in bag. Pick up charger. Place in bag. Zip bag. Pick up phone. Place in pocket. Check mirror. Adjust hair. Walk out of bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to arts organization office with Member 1 (leaving together)
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of house with Member 1. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Swipe card. Find seat. Sit down. Talk to Member 1. Look out window. Check phone. Arrive at stop. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk to office. Enter building. Greet receptionist. Walk to desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the arts organization office on program administration, scheduling and artist liaison tasks
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Open calendar. Schedule meeting. Make phone calls. Talk to artists. Take notes. Print documents. File papers. Attend meeting. Take minutes. Discuss budget.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break and eating lunch nearby
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from desk. Walk to elevator. Press button. Wait. Enter elevator. Press ground floor. Exit elevator. Walk out of building. Walk to cafe. Enter cafe. Order food. Pay. Receive food. Find table. Sit down. Eat sandwich. Drink water. Wipe mouth. Stand up. Throw trash. Walk back to office. Enter building. Walk to desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the arts organization office on exhibition planning and budget coordination
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open spreadsheet. Enter data. Calculate budget. Call vendors. Negotiate prices. Email artists. Update exhibition plan. Print layout. Review with colleague. Make notes. Adjust timeline. File documents. Attend conference call. Take notes. Send follow-up emails.
Walk to station. Board train. Sit. Talk to Member 1. Check phone. Exit train. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter house.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into kitchen. Wash hands. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Place on cutting board. Pick up knife. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add spices. Turn off stove. Pick up plates. Serve food. Sit at table. Eat. Talk to Member 1. Drink water. Finish eating. Stand up. Pick up plates. Walk to sink. Rinse plates. Place in dishwasher. Wipe table.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing and watching TV with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch. Talk to Member 1. Laugh. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Adjust volume. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Get snack. Walk back. Sit down. Continue watching.

enriched_activities.activity: Doing freelance illustration work on the computer, using the monitor and desk lamp
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Turn on computer. Connect to monitor. Adjust monitor angle. Open illustration software. Pick up stylus. Draw. Use monitor. Adjust lamp. Sketch. Zoom in. Zoom out. Undo. Redo. Change brush size. Change color. Save file. Check email.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening wash and skin care routine
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet face. Apply cleanser. Rub face. Rinse. Pat dry. Apply toner. Apply moisturizer. Brush teeth. Use toilet. Flush. Wash hands. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Light reading and winding down with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up book. Open book. Read. Turn page. Talk to Member 1. Close book. Put down book. Stand up. Stretch. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping, with the space heater on low
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into bedroom. Turn on space heater. Adjust to low. Turn off desk lamp. Take off clothes. Put on pajamas. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn over. Adjust pillow. Continue sleeping.
